name: wr90_magictee_double_ridge_seed_current
status: analytic seed; requires HFSS eigenmode, de-embedding, and full 3-D validation

reduced_model.conditional_load_note: The historical ZL/Zref=0.5 model is only an initializer. Production design uses mixed-mode Sigma/Delta extraction from the actual magic-tee junction.

taper.note: Do not linearly or smoothstep-interpolate geometry and assume impedance is smooth. Construct a target log-impedance trajectory and invert the Cohn reduced model for geometry before HFSS calibration.

tuning_bolts.role: residual susceptance and ripple correction only
tuning_bolts.spacing_note: Near f0, lambda_g/4 is about 8.50 mm in section 2 and 9.07 mm in section 1. Use this only as a phasor-cancellation seed.

hfss_validation_order: uniform ridge section eigenmodes and wave-port normalization
magic-tee plus nearest taper as one coupled 3-D block
four-way tree under equal-amplitude equal-phase excitation
finite conductivity, peak field, and thermal-loss checks
